name: Look around
command: What do you see on my table?
description: Raise the camera, capture three views, describe the table, and return home.

name: Bring water
command: Bring this water bottle to me.
description: Deliver the blue-and-white water carton to the predefined blue tape marker.

name: Return water
description: Return the carton to its saved pickup position and go home.

name: Check robot
description: Read connection, arm, gripper, and setup status. No motion.

name: Prepare robot
description: Return an empty arm to the checked observation pose.

name: Run motion check
description: Turn the empty arm 5° and return; verify both endpoints.

name: Vision round trip
description: Run the established vision-guided carton A → B → A demo; verify each placement and return home.
suggestion: Move the carton to point B and then back to A.
